title: Hederagenin improves Alzheimer's disease through PPARalpha/TFEB-mediated autophagy.
authors: Xie, Zhi-Shen; Zhao, Jian-Ping; Wu, Li-Min; Chu, Shuang; Cui, Zheng-Hao; Sun, Yi-Ran; Wang, Hui; Ma, Hui-Fen; Ma, Dong-Rui; Wang, Pan; Zhang, Xiao-Wei; Zhang, Zhen-Qiang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Hederagenin通过PPARalpha/TFEB通路改善阿尔茨海默病，涉及分子对接和MD模拟但核心是疾病治疗与自噬机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Autophagic flux is coordinated by a network of master regulatory genes, which centered on transcription factor EB (TFEB). The disorders of autophagic flux are closely associated with Alzheimer's disease (AD), and thus restoring autophagic flux to degrade pathogenic proteins has become a hot therapeutic strategy. Hederagenin (HD), a triterpene compound, isolated from a variety food such as Matoa (Pometia pinnata) Fruit, Medicago sativa, Medicago polymorpha L. Previous studies have shown that HD has the neuroprotective effect. However, the effect of HD on AD and underlying mechanisms are unclear. PURPOSE: To determine the effect of HD on AD and whether it promotes autophagy to reduce AD symptoms. STUDY DESIGN: BV2 cells, C. elegans and APP/PS1 transgenic mice were used to explore the alleviative effect of HD on AD and the molecular mechanism in vivo and in vitro. METHODS: The APP/PS1 transgenic mice at 10 months were randomized into 5 groups (n = 10 in each group) and orally administrated with either vehicle (0.5% CMCNa), WY14643 (10 mg/kg/d), low-dose of HD (25 mg/kg/d), high-dose of HD (50 mg/kg/d) or MK-886 (10 mg/kg/d) + HD (50 mg/kg/d) for consecutive 2 months. The behavioral experiments including morris water maze test, object recognition test and Y maze test were performed. The effects of HD on Abeta deposition and alleviates Abeta pathology in transgenic C. elegans were operated using paralysis assay and fluorescence staining assay. The roles of HD in promoting PPARalpha/TFEB-dependent autophagy were investigated using the BV2 cells via western blot analysis, real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR), molecular docking, molecular dynamic (MD) simulation, electron microscope assay and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: In this study, we found that HD upregulated mRNA and protein level of TFEB and increased the distribution of TFEB in the nucleus, and the expressions of its target genes. HD also promoted the expressions of LC3BII/LC3BI, LAMP2, etc., and promoted autophagy and the degradation of Abeta. HD reduced Abeta deposition in the head area of C. elegans and Abeta-induced paralysis. HD improved cognitive impairment and pathological changes in APP/PS1 mice by promoting autophagy and activating TFEB. And our results also showed that HD could strongly target PPARalpha. More importantly, these effects were reversed by treatment of MK-886, a selective PPARalpha antagonist. CONCLUSION: Our present findings demonstrated that HD attenuated the pathology of AD through inducing autophagy and the underlying mechanism associated with PPARalpha/TFEB pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：自噬流由以转录因子EB（TFEB）为中心的主调控基因网络协调。自噬流紊乱与阿尔茨海默病（AD）密切相关，因此恢复自噬流以降解致病蛋白已成为一种热门的治疗策略。常春藤皂苷元（HD）是一种三萜类化合物，从多种食物中分离得到，如马托阿果（Pometia pinnata）、紫花苜蓿（Medicago sativa）、南苜蓿（Medicago polymorpha L.）。既往研究表明HD具有神经保护作用。然而，HD对AD的作用及其潜在机制尚不清楚。目的：确定HD对AD的作用，并探讨其是否通过促进自噬来减轻AD症状。研究设计：使用BV2细胞、秀丽隐杆线虫和APP/PS1转基因小鼠，在体内和体外探索HD对AD的缓解作用及分子机制。方法：将10月龄APP/PS1转基因小鼠随机分为5组（每组n=10），分别口服给予载体（0.5% CMCNa）、WY14643（10 mg/kg/d）、低剂量HD（25 mg/kg/d）、高剂量HD（50 mg/kg/d）或MK-886（10 mg/kg/d）+ HD（50 mg/kg/d），连续给药2个月。进行行为学实验，包括莫里斯水迷宫测试、物体识别测试和Y迷宫测试。通过麻痹实验和荧光染色实验，评估HD对转基因线虫中Aβ沉积的影响及缓解Aβ病理的作用。利用BV2细胞，通过蛋白质印迹分析、实时定量PCR（RT-qPCR）、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟、电子显微镜实验和免疫荧光，研究HD在促进PPARα/TFEB依赖性自噬中的作用。结果：本研究发现，HD上调TFEB的mRNA和蛋白水平，增加TFEB在细胞核中的分布及其靶基因的表达。HD还促进LC3BII/LC3BI、LAMP2等的表达，促进自噬和Aβ的降解。HD减少线虫头部区域的Aβ沉积及Aβ诱导的麻痹。HD通过促进自噬和激活TFEB，改善APP/PS1小鼠的认知障碍和病理变化。此外，我们的结果还表明HD能强烈靶向PPARα。更重要的是，这些效应被选择性PPARα拮抗剂MK-886的处理所逆转。结论：我们的研究结果表明，HD通过诱导自噬减轻AD病理，其潜在机制与PPARα/TFEB通路相关。
